newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to cut access charges by 12 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: NTT to cut access charges by 12 pct - paper.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) is to cut the access fees it charges to other domestic long-distance carriers for use of its facilities by 12 percent, a Japanese business daily said.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday the new rates will be retroactively applied to the long-distance telecommunications companies' business from April 1996.
The move is expected to further boost price competition among telecommunications operators, the paper said.
A spokesman for NTT, which operates both local and long-distance services, said he was checking the report.
